strings.seo.title: Saudi Visit Visa Guide for Al-Ahsa: Choose Your Route
strings.seo.description: Choose the right Saudi visit visa for your Al-Ahsa trip in minutes: 8 routes, who each is for, its validity, and the official link to apply. Start planning now.
strings.h1: Saudi Visit Visa: A Short Guide for Your Al-Ahsa Trip
strings.lead: Your trip to Al-Ahsa starts with one step: the Saudi visit visa that fits you. This guide brings the eight visa routes together on one page and tells you briefly who each route is for, how long its visa lasts, and where to apply. It then hands you over to the government platform to complete your application there.
strings.feesLine: Fees are shown when you apply on the official platform.
strings.verifyLine: Check the official source before applying, as conditions may change.
strings.intro.parts: Al-Ahsa Oasis is inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, and is home to Jabal Al-Qarah, Qasr Ibrahim, Al-Qaisariyah Souq, the oasis springs and its palms. Browse [Al-Ahsa's attractions](/en/attractions/), check the [events](/en/events/) close to your travel dates, choose [where to stay](/en/stay/), then [plan your trip](/en/plan-your-trip/) in detail. If you are looking for a tourist visa for Al-Ahsa specifically, Al-Ahsa is a Saudi city, and a Saudi visit visa is what you need.
strings.table.caption: The eight Saudi visit visa routes at a glance
strings.table.rows.0.1: Citizens of eligible countries, holders of Schengen, US or UK visas, permanent residents of the US, the EU or the UK, and GCC residents
strings.table.rows.0.2: 1 year, multiple entry, stay up to 3 months
strings.table.rows.1.1: Holders of a GCC residency valid for at least 3 months
strings.table.rows.1.2: 1 year with a 90-day stay (multiple entry), or 90 days (single entry)
strings.table.rows.2.2: 365 days, multiple entry, cumulative stay up to 90 days
strings.table.rows.3.1: Saudia or flynas passengers with a stopover in the Kingdom
strings.table.rows.4.1: Those invited by a citizen or resident
strings.table.rows.5.1: Those invited by a company or organisation in the Kingdom
strings.table.rows.6.1: Passport holders of India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Egypt, Jordan and Mexico
strings.routes.tourist.h: Saudi tourist eVisa: who is it for?
strings.routes.tourist.who.label: Who is this visa for?
strings.routes.tourist.who.text: Citizens of the eligible countries listed on the platform; holders of a valid Schengen, US or UK visit visa; permanent residents of the US, the EU or the UK; and residents of GCC countries. It covers tourism, attending events, visiting relatives and Umrah. It does not cover Hajj, work or study.
strings.routes.tourist.validity.label: Validity and length of stay:
strings.routes.tourist.validity.text: One year from the date of issue, multiple entry, with a stay of up to 3 months.
strings.routes.tourist.cta.label: Apply on the official platform
strings.routes.gcc.h: Saudi visa guide for GCC residents: visiting Al-Ahsa
strings.routes.gcc.who.label: Who is this visa for?
strings.routes.gcc.who.text: Residents of a GCC country holding a residency valid for at least 3 months.
strings.routes.gcc.validity.label: Validity and length of stay:
strings.routes.gcc.validity.text: Two options: multiple entry valid for one year with a 90-day stay, or single entry valid for 90 days with a 90-day stay.
strings.routes.gcc.cta.label: Apply on the official platform
strings.routes.umrah.who.label: Who is this visa for?
strings.routes.umrah.who.text: Those wishing to perform Umrah through packages from licensed service providers. Nusuk also offers visa-free packages for GCC citizens and residents and for holders of all visa types.
strings.routes.umrah.validity.label: Validity and length of stay:
strings.routes.umrah.validity.text: 365 days from the date of issue, multiple entry, with a cumulative stay of up to 90 days.
strings.routes.umrah.cta.label: Apply on the official platform
strings.routes.stopover.h: Stopover (transit) visa for a layover in Saudi Arabia
strings.routes.stopover.who.label: Who is this visa for?
strings.routes.stopover.who.text: Passengers booking a Saudia or flynas flight that includes a stopover in the Kingdom. It is requested during flight booking.
strings.routes.stopover.validity.label: Length of stay:
strings.routes.stopover.cta.label: See the details on the official page
strings.routes.family.who.label: Who is this visa for?
strings.routes.family.who.text: Those invited by a Saudi citizen or resident. The family visit is for relatives: first-degree relatives of GCC citizens (parents, spouse and children), and relatives of residents. The personal visit is for those with no family or business relationship to the host. The host starts the application online on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs platform.
strings.routes.family.cta.label: The host starts the application on the official platform
strings.routes.business.who.text: For those invited by a company or organisation in the Kingdom with which they have a business relationship. The inviting organisation starts the application, which is then completed on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs platform.
strings.routes.business.cta.label: The host starts the application on the official platform
strings.routes.package.who.text: For passport holders of India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Egypt, Jordan and Mexico, through a flight and accommodation package from a licensed service provider.
strings.routes.package.cta.label: See the details on the official page
strings.routes.uk.h: Electronic Travel Authorisation for UK citizens
strings.routes.uk.who.text: For UK citizens, with a separate application for each person, including children. It allows multiple visits over two years.
strings.routes.uk.cta.label: Apply on the official platform
strings.arrive.h: How do you get to Al-Ahsa after your visa?
strings.arrive.air: By air: via Al-Ahsa International Airport, or King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and onward by car or train.
strings.arrive.land: By land from Bahrain: via the King Fahd Causeway. Before travelling, check the entry conditions for the causeway on the [King Fahd Causeway Authority](https://kfca.sa/en/) website, and the entry conditions for each border crossing at the [Visit Saudi help center](https://www.visitsaudi.com/en/help-center).
strings.arrive.more: Details on arriving by train and car, and distances from Riyadh and Dammam, are in [How to get there](/en/plan-your-trip/#getting-there).

strings.faq.h: Frequently asked questions about the Saudi visit visa
strings.faq.items.0.q: How long is the Saudi tourist eVisa valid?
strings.faq.items.0.a: It is valid for one year from the date of issue with multiple entry, and each stay can last up to 3 months.
strings.faq.items.1.q: Can the tourist eVisa be extended?
strings.faq.items.1.a: No. If it expires before you enter the Kingdom, a new application is required.
strings.faq.items.2.q: Do GCC residents need a visa to visit Al-Ahsa?
strings.faq.items.2.a: Yes. They apply through the GCC residents route on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs platform (ksavisa.sa).
strings.faq.items.3.q: Can I perform Umrah on a tourist visa?
strings.faq.items.3.a: Yes. Umrah is among the activities permitted on the tourist eVisa, with the exception of Hajj.
strings.faq.items.4.q: Can I work on a tourist visa?
strings.faq.items.4.a: No. The tourist visa is for tourism, attending events, Umrah and visiting relatives. It does not permit work or study.
strings.faq.items.5.q: How do I invite a relative to visit me in Al-Ahsa?
strings.faq.items.5.a: The host starts the application online on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs visa platform, and must be related to the guest.
strings.faq.items.6.q: I have a stopover in Saudi Arabia. Can I leave the airport?
strings.faq.items.6.a: Yes. Saudia and flynas passengers can obtain a stopover visa during flight booking, for a stay of up to 96 hours.
